Hi,

I've gone through all threads on "Shiny.onInputChange" so hopefully I'm not duplicating a question. 

I'm building a shiny app with some extra d3 graphing capability implemented through htmlwidgets. Following this tutorial I was easily able to implement addCustomMessageHandler for sending messages from R to my js library. The other direction seems to be more tricky. I'm trying to add a listener to a label on a line graph and send a message to R reporting the position of the label. The d3 listener works fine (I can see that through console.log) so I tried to add Shiny.onInputChange to the listeners function but its not working.

I draw the graph only after loading data which is sent through a dialog. Is it possible that at this point (drawing the graph) it is too late to register the input variable which is the first argument of the Shiny.onInputChange function? If so, can I register it somehow sooner without having the data initialised? 

Thanks for any hints and pointer.

Karol
